name: Balsamiq
description:
Connect Claude to your Balsamiq Cloud projects, so you can create, edit, and analyze wireframes without leaving the conversation. Describe what you want and Claude builds it as a board in your project; point it at designs you already have and it reads them to help you plan, review, and build.
Key features:
- Create wireframes from a prompt: describe a screen, or attach a screenshot to recreate, and Claude builds it as a new board.
- Edit boards: ask for targeted changes and Claude adds, adjusts, or removes elements without disturbing the rest of the design.
- Read designs in full: Claude pulls the complete control hierarchy, including the sticky notes and arrows that carry design intent, plus board previews and comment threads.
- Turn designs into deliverables: generate user stories, QA test plans, edge-case analysis, or working code that fits your codebase.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Balsamiq to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Balsamiq to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://bais.balsamiq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Balsamiq MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Balsamiq provides these MCP tools: create_balsamiq_board, edit_balsamiq_board, get_balsamiq_board_comments, get_balsamiq_board_content, get_balsamiq_board_preview, get_balsamiq_project_toc, and list_balsamiq_projects.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Balsamiq?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Balsamiq in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Balsamiq requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Balsamiq is developed by Balsamiq. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
